scope: Built Next production server on localhost, actual nonce CSP, headless Edge

checks.name: Native 1080p streaming starts under the real response CSP
Forward and reverse scrolling present actual video frames
The content-hashed original stream uses one completed fetch without seek ranges
Pause freezes presented frames; resume reaches the new position
Offstage motion stops and a top return restores the opening
Record real frame intervals during a continuous warm forward/reverse sweep

detail.acceptance: Observation, not a universal FPS assertion

checks.name: Both individual pricing controls expand and collapse both offers
All five full previews retain sufficient resolution and contain framing
reduced-motion keeps static readable entry and makes no video request
touch keeps static readable entry and makes no video request
no-js keeps static readable entry and makes no video request
Explicit simulation: unavailable worker MediaSource falls back to main-thread MSE
Skipping entry before delayed real media readiness never expands or starts the hero
No uncaught JavaScript errors or browser CSP violations

limitations: Browser automation does not establish physical presentation or universal smoothness.
Touch is emulated. The fallback capability override is explicitly a simulation.
Frame intervals come from real requestVideoFrameCallback metadata during the recorded sweep; no hardware FPS guarantee follows.
